THE SALES & LEADERSHIP CURRICULUM

Field-proven modules.
Measurable margin uplift.

Explore the core training sprints built specifically for branch managers, external technical reps, and commercial directors in UK industry.

Eliminate unproductive chasing and build disciplined discovery habits across commercial and branch sales teams.

  • Decision-maker identification: Accessing real budget holders and directors rather than gatekeepers.
  • Opportunity qualification frameworks: Focusing external reps exclusively on high-probability, high-margin jobs.
  • Outbound cadence design: Combining email, telephone, and verified LinkedIn outreach for consistent pipeline.

Stop trading away margin under competitive contractor price pressure.

  • Rebate, terms, and cost-of-delay negotiation tactics that protect gross profit percentages.
  • Specification selling: Locking in technical product advantages early in the contractor estimating cycle.
  • Live objection handling clinics using recordings of actual customer negotiations.

Empower branch managers to run their unit as a high-performing commercial business.

  • Weekly trade counter and sales cadence: Target account reviews, quote tracking, and pipeline velocity.
  • Underperformer turnarounds: Clear coaching expectations, delegation, and accountability metrics.
  • Key customer retention rituals: Defending top 20 accounts from aggressive competitor poaching.

Equip commercial teams to use modern AI intelligence safely to multiply sales output.

  • Pre-call intelligence briefs: Instant account history and Companies House financial summaries.
  • Quote follow-up automation with human approval: Never let a profitable quote slip through the cracks.
  • Responsible UK GDPR and commercial data isolation habits.
